overloadMerges.note: The mechanical parser defaulted volumes to direction 'in', but the parameter table arrow ('←') and description ('populates the text array volumes') show it is an output parameter filled in by the command.

params.name: volumes
params.description: Names of the volumes currently mounted

constraints: On Windows, all currently defined volumes are returned whether or not physically present (e.g. an optical drive letter is returned even with no disc inserted); on Macintosh, only volumes currently visible at the Finder level are returned.
Volume names are followed by the platform's folder separator character.
